title: Hello Darkness #27
desc:
Your favorite horror anthology is back with another issue of tantalizingly gruesome original stories!

Brock's unsettling journey continues in "The Arrangement Part Two," where he's become overwhelmed by the physical changes from his pregnancy. But Dr. Alan reassures him everything's completely normal, stabbing pains and all! You won't believe what happens next in this gut-wrenching body horror tale from writer Mark Bouchard and artist Val Halvorson.

Then strap in for a diving expedition that will make your skin crawl, LITERALLY, in Garet Wareing and Piotr Kowalski's "Skin Diver."

And finally, prepare to meet "The Carvers," a family that stays together and SLAYS together with newcomer creators and burgeoning superstars writer Breyden Boyd and artist Nathan Wells.
